title: EFC -- Formal Specification
abstract: Formal specification of the EFC framework. Defines mathematical objects, field equations, structural relations, and thermodynamic constraints. Serves as the canonical reference for notation, symbols, field interactions, and governing principles.
key_results: Canonical notation for all EFC symbols and operators
Formal field equation: G_uv = 8piG(T_uv + T^(Ef)_uv) + Lambda_eff g_uv
Entropy sigmoid S(a) formal definition with boundary conditions
Thermodynamic constraint set ensuring second-law compliance
Grid field formal structure and emergent geometry conditions
